```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggtext)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(vegan)
```

```{r}
king <- read.csv("/Users/baileyconrad/Desktop/bewell/data/derived/RelAbun/RelAbun_king.csv")
phyl <- read.csv("/Users/baileyconrad/Desktop/bewell/data/derived/RelAbun/RelAbun_phyl.csv")
class <- read.csv("/Users/baileyconrad/Desktop/bewell/data/derived/RelAbun/RelAbun_class.csv")
ord <- read.csv("/Users/baileyconrad/Desktop/bewell/data/derived/RelAbun/RelAbun_ord.csv")
fam <- read.csv("/Users/baileyconrad/Desktop/bewell/data/derived/RelAbun/RelAbun_fam.csv")
gen <- read.csv("/Users/baileyconrad/Desktop/bewell/data/derived/RelAbun/RelAbun_gen.csv")
spec <- read.csv("/Users/baileyconrad/Desktop/bewell/data/derived/RelAbun/RelAbun_spec.csv")
samplabs <- read.csv("/Users/baileyconrad/Desktop/bewell/data/derived/timepoint_key.csv")
```

#Combine Data
```{r}
combine_taxa <- list(king, phyl, class, ord, fam, gen, spec) %>%
  reduce(full_join, by='X') %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "X")

samplab.form <- samplabs %>%
  select(Subject.Number, placebo) %>%
  mutate(rP = ifelse(placebo == "Week 0", 1, 3),
        tP = ifelse(placebo == "Week 0", 2, 4),
        rB = ifelse(placebo == "Week 0", 3, 1),
        tB = ifelse(placebo == "Week 0", 4, 2)) %>%
  pivot_longer(names_to = "Timepoint", values_to = "timepoints", cols = c("rP", "tP", "rB", "tB")) %>%
  mutate(Sample = paste0(Subject.Number, "-", Timepoint))
```

```{r}
shannon<-diversity(combine_taxa, index = "shannon")
shan<-as.data.frame(shannon) %>%
   rownames_to_column(var = "Sample")

shan_plot <- merge(samplab.form, shan, by = "Sample") %>%
  ggplot()  +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = timepoints, y = shannon, group = timepoints)) +
  ggtitle("Shannon")

shan_plot
```

```{r}
simpson<-diversity(combine_taxa, index = "simpson")
simp<-as.data.frame(simpson) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Sample")

simp_plot <- merge(samplab.form, simp, by = "Sample") %>%
  ggplot()  +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = timepoints, y = simpson, group = timepoints)) +

simp_plot
```

```{r}
invsimpson<-1/simpson
invsimp<-as.data.frame(invsimpson) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Sample")

invsimp_plot <- merge(samplab.form, invsimp, by = "Sample") %>%
  ggplot()  +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = timepoints, y = invsimpson, group = timepoints)) +
  ggtitle("Inverse Simpson")

invsimp_plot
```

